open.thesis: Split out of the validator-drift thesis, which was closed today on its validator half. RUNBOOK.md KNOWN LIMITATIONS still reads 'seasonProj is assumed live, not proven ... if two snapshots days apart show identical numbers, it is a preseason artifact.' That is settled and settled the other way: chem-seasonproj-live-2026-09-21 proved the field recomputes after each slate by diffing two commits, 245 of 250 season projections changed. A run that follows the runbook literally here will under-trust a live field. The REAL limitation, observed again today, is different and narrower: seasonProj does not price AVAILABILITY. Don't re-add Pitts behind Likely. Likely was never on a Giants report through Week 4; a second tight end had no lineup path. The separate drop-risk entry on Pitts stays open until tonight.
Watch Tre Tucker. The falsifier fired on the archive: Bowers drew 13 and 11 targets in Weeks 3-4 while Tucker had 4 and 8 for 8.3 and 8.4. Week 2 was the touchdown. Never added, so no points lost.
